name: Calcupine
tagline: Home project calculators that tell you exactly what to buy.

Noah Scott.bio: Noah Scott writes Calcupine's project guides. Every guide starts from what homeowners are searching for right now, is researched from manufacturer data, university extension advice and building standards, and is checked against our calculators before it goes live.

walls.title: Wall and Ceiling Calculators: Paint, Drywall, Insulation
walls.description: Free wall calculators: gallons of paint, drywall sheets, wallpaper rolls, bags of insulation, baseboard and trim, and bricks with mortar and ties.
walls.intro: Planning to paint, hang drywall or wallpaper a room? Each calculator takes your room size in feet and inches, subtracts doors and windows, adds the waste the trades plan for and tells you what to buy in store units: gallons and quarts, 4 by 8 or 4 by 12 sheets, or double rolls. Insulation is worked out in bags of batts or blown-in fill for the R-value you want, and baseboard and casing in 8, 12 or 16 ft pieces. The brick calculator counts modular, queen, king, Norman or utility brick for a wall, with bags of mortar mix and veneer ties.

floors.title: Floor Calculators: Flooring, Tile, Grout, Square Footage
floors.description: Free floor calculators: boxes of flooring with waste, tiles with thinset, bags of grout for any joint size, and square footage for odd-shaped rooms.
floors.intro: Measure once and get the square footage, the number of boxes or tiles and the extras you need for a floor. The calculators handle L-shaped rooms and cut-outs, add extra waste for diagonal and herringbone tile layouts, and round up to full boxes after the waste is added. The grout calculator turns your tile size, joint width and tile thickness into pounds and bags of sanded or non-sanded grout, or pails of pre-mixed.

concrete.title: Concrete, Paver and Fill Calculators: Bags and Yards
concrete.description: Free calculators for concrete bags or yards, patio pavers with base and sand, tons of gravel for a driveway, and cubic yards of fill.
concrete.intro: Work out concrete for slabs, footings, post holes, steps and curbs in 40, 60 or 80 lb bags or ready-mix yards, pavers with the gravel base and bedding sand under them, and cubic yards of any fill from length, width and depth. The gravel driveway calculator gives the tons of base, middle and surface stone for each layer.

outdoor.title: Yard and Garden Calculators: Mulch, Walls, Fence, Deck
outdoor.description: Free yard and garden calculators: mulch, soil and gravel, sod and seed, retaining wall blocks with drainage stone, fence posts and pickets, and deck boards.
outdoor.intro: Outdoor projects are bought by the bag, the pallet, the post and the board. These calculators turn your yard measurements into those units: bags or bulk yards of mulch, soil and gravel, pallets of sod or pounds of seed, retaining wall blocks with the base and drainage stone behind them, every fence post, rail and picket, and deck boards with joists and screws.

structure.title: Roof and Stair Calculators: Shingles and Stair Layout
structure.description: Free roof and stair calculators: bundles of shingles, underlayment and drip edge from your house size and pitch, and stair risers, treads and stringers.
structure.intro: Get roofing squares and bundles of shingles from the outside size of your house, the overhang and the roof pitch, and lay out stairs with the number of risers, tread depth and stringer length, checked against common building code limits.
